params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia engineer quits over secrecy around Jensen Huang's exit A robotics engineer at Nvidia has left the company, saying there was a lack of transparency about how former CEO Jensen Huang departed. He joins a growing group of unhappy staff, while the online petition to bring Huang back has now passed 150,000 signatures. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 20:56 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia 👀 React if you're following this saga · 💬 Should Huang come back? #NVIDIA #JensenHuang #TechNews #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
